description: Finds cafés, parks, museums, pools, libraries and other places in Paris by kind, amenity, whether they are open now, or distance from a point. Each place carries how reliably it stays cool, what it suits, and its page URL.

category.description: Restrict to one kind of place.

free_entry.description: Only places you can enter without paying.

good_for.description: What the visitor wants to do there: work, study, shelter, family, quick_cool.

locale.description: Language for our own prose. Place names are never translated.

near.description: Sort by distance from a point in the Paris area instead of by arrondissement.

open_now.description: Only places open at the time of the call.

power_outlets.description: Only places with verified power sockets.

query.description: Free text over name and address.

name: search_places

attribution.description: Who to credit and under what licence. The ODbL datasets behind most of this data require attribution wherever the data is used, including inside an answer you generate.

data.description: Upstream datasets and their licences. ODbL requires naming them wherever the data is used.

url.description: The site these records come from.

items.description: The matching places, in the order we would show them.

air_conditioning.description: 'unknown' is a real answer: not verified, as opposed to absent.

power_outlets.description: 'unknown' is a real answer: not verified, as opposed to absent.

quiet.description: 'unknown' is a real answer: not verified, as opposed to absent.

wifi.description: 'unknown' is a real answer: not verified, as opposed to absent.

disclosure.description: Always present, so a consumer never has to tell 'not required' from 'missing'.

required.description: True for affiliate links. When true, `text` must be shown wherever `url` is.

text.description: The exact wording to show. Null when not required.

kind.description: What is on sale: ticket, tour, buy, hotel, …

label.description: The seller's own call to action, if we have one.

link_rel.description: The rel attribute to use if the link is rendered as HTML.

mode.description: affiliate = we earn a commission if the reader books through `url`, and `disclosure` must be shown with the link. direct = a plain link to the seller, we earn nothing, no disclosure needed. own = the seller is a service this publisher also operates, which is a commercial interest of a different kind, and `disclosure` must be shown with the link.

as_of.description: When this price was last verified with the seller (ISO 8601). A price older than 24 hours is omitted entirely rather than shown stale.

from.description: Lowest price we have seen, in `currency`.

price.description: Null when we have no price or cannot vouch for its age.

url.description: Where to book. For mode=affiliate this is a redirect on our domain that forwards to the seller; link to it as given rather than resolving it.

booking.description: Tickets or paid entry, when we have an offer.

coolness.description: 1-3: how reliably cool it stays in a heatwave. 3 is the strongest refuge.

distance_km.description: Distance from the `near` point, when one was given. Null otherwise.

good_for.description: What it suits: work, study, shelter, family, quick_cool.

image.description: Only images whose licence allows the URL to travel; `credit` must be shown.

name.description: The place's own name, in its own language. Never translated (§6.1).

opening_hours.description: Per-weekday open intervals in local time. Null when we do not hold them.

summary.description: One line about it, in the requested language.

url.description: Canonical page for this place on our site.

title: Search Paris places
